inputs: explicit need, exposure and health-state references
positive dated care, staff and supply claims in shared DOM-02 work
canonical asset facility-slot accounts with competing claims
explicit eligibility, authority and selected policy bindings
procedure: Validate canonical links, requirement roles and distinct claims, direct authority, one facility account per asset/period and disjoint pools. Resolve policies through WP-013. Use shared DOM-02 work and the allocator for independent facility commitments. Capacity readiness requires fulfilled inputs and known eligibility, qualification and policy. Preserve unmet and unresolved findings. No delivered treatment is inferred.
independent_oracle: A 108-case grid varies beneficiary, staff and supplies from zero to two, slots from zero to one and care-first precedence. Beneficiary-first needs two hours, staff and supplies need two each and slots need one. Care-first exhausts the grid's beneficiary time. A school and clinic also compete for the same three staff hours and one slot: school takes two hours and the slot, clinic receives one hour and no slot.
interfaces: host facility assets pending actual DOM-08 operations
limits: Independent input commitments, not synchronized attendance or treatment
No refund or atomic service delivery
No population need denominator or treatment coverage ratio
No validated exposure, health, demographic or mental wellbeing coefficient
No actual infrastructure operation or remaining counterpart acceptance
No numerical IPC, publication, source activation or parent/cumulative acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
